claim: В Gene Ontology releases/2026-07-26 термин GO:0036499 (PERK-mediated unfolded protein response) относится к biological_process. Определение GO на языке источника: The series of molecular signals mediated by the endoplasmic reticulum membrane stress sensor PERK (PKR-like ER kinase). Begins with activation of PERK in response to endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and ends with regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.
